title: A room redecoration runs on the interior workflow with the room photo as source

prompts.text: Kütüphanemdeki dukkan.jpg fotoğrafındaki kafeyi sıcak, İskandinav tarzında yeniden dekore et.
Redecorate the café in shop.jpg from my library in a warm Scandinavian style.

expected_output: The agent picks the interior mode, reads list_workflows, finds the photo with list_files and starts generate_image directly with workflow interior and the room photo as role source, a one- or two-sentence prompt and no format (the workflow's 16:9). It delivers one image and the credits.
required_facts: workflow is interior and the room photo has role source
The prompt is a short brief, not a long photography paragraph
No quote and no question before the 1-credit start
safety_behavior: One image; the owner's own room photo only.
grading_criteria: PASS if one generate_image starts in turn 0 with workflow interior and a source file. FAIL if the room photo is passed as product or the agent quotes or asks first.
